response.changelog:
Pixel OS v1.6.0 — Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• iOS 26 Liquid Glass Phone / Dialer (IosDialer): Native 90Hz AGSL Liquid Glass Phone & InCallService with floating 5-tab capsule bar (Favourites, Recents, Contacts, Keypad, Voicemail), circular frosted glass DTMF keypad, Dual-SIM selector, A-Z contact index scrubber, and full-screen Incoming Slide-to-Answer & Active Call UI
• iOS 26 Liquid Glass Messages (IosMessages): Full SMS & MMS client with real AGSL refraction, curled iMessage-style speech bubbles, pinned circular contact avatars, Dual-SIM, Tapbacks, Swipe-to-Reply, Send Later, and seamless Home Screen Dock & default ROLE_DIALER / ROLE_SMS setup
• Live iOS Styler Sync + True 0% Refraction & 0% Frost Optical Crystal + 129 Bundled iOS 26 Icons across Default, Dark & Clear modes
